text: I feel a certain anticipation slipping into the unknown. The clean, modern glass and sterile features set my mind towards observation and contemplation. As I move closer, colorful displays and intriguing text invite me to reflect on the interplay between knowledge and creativity. The repetition of 'R+D' reminds me of endless cycles of discovery and wonder. I feel like both a visitor and a participant, slightly out of place yet drawn into the possibilities offered here. Curiosity grows—a silent thrill beneath the surface.
